row.evidence: Kustomer's pricing details page shows SCIM as "No" on Enterprise and included on Ultimate, with SAML SSO a paid add-on on Enterprise; plan prices are not published.
row.notes: Kustomer no longer publishes prices ("we don't post one-size-fits-all pricing"); the comprehensive pricing details page (last updated December 19, 2025) lists two current plans, Enterprise and Ultimate, with SCIM only on Ultimate and SAML SSO a paid ($) add-on on Enterprise. Legacy seat-based plans show no SCIM; legacy usage-based ProfessionalAI/EnterpriseAI/UltimateAI plans all list SCIM. SCIM 2.0 endpoint at https://[orgname].api.kustomerapp.com/v1/scim/v2 authenticated with a Kustomer API key; setup is documented for Okta (custom SAML app with SCIM, not an OIN catalogue app) and OneLogin (generic SCIM Provisioner). Okta's guide notes Okta Lifecycle Management is needed on the Okta side. SCIM cannot manage org owners. No Entra, Google or JumpCloud provisioning guide found.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: SAML SSO available as a paid add-on ($ = available with additional charge). API rate limit 1,000 RPM.

auth.token_source: Kustomer Settings > Security > API Keys > Add API Key (roles org.admin, org.user, org.hooks, org.permission, org.tracking)

deprovision.data_retained: Deactivated users keep their team assignments; a reactivated user is back in the same teams.

custom.how: UserType (user, limited = collaborator, seasonal), PermissionSets (array of permission set IDs) and DisplayName, sent in the core User namespace (urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:core:2.0:User).

group: displayName (Okta pushed group becomes a Kustomer Team)

roles.how: PermissionSets attribute with Kustomer permission set IDs per user, or permission sets assigned to a Team that a pushed group maps to.

limitations.text: SCIM cannot manage users with org owner permissions; updates to org owners are dropped.
Team names with an emoji make Okta's Import Groups fail.
Okta setup needs Okta Lifecycle Management or Advanced Lifecycle Management on the Okta side.
Deactivating a user does not remove their team memberships.

auth.notes: Bearer API key created under Settings > Security > API Keys with role scopes.

endpoints.purpose: Update user (deleted: true deletes, deleted: null restores)

rate_limits.text: 1,000 requests per minute on Enterprise, 2,000 on Ultimate.

okta.notes: No Kustomer app in the OIN; Kustomer's guide has admins create a custom SAML app and turn on SCIM provisioning on it.

entra.notes: Kustomer documents SAML SSO with Entra (Ultimate or SAML add-on) but no Entra provisioning guide.

onelogin.notes: Kustomer's guide uses OneLogin's generic SCIM Provisioner with SAML (SCIM v2 Core).

fallbacks.other_sync: Bulk user import via webhooks, workflows or Data Connect

conflicts.text: The main pricing page shows a single package with SAML SSO and SCIM included, while the comprehensive pricing details page splits current pricing into Enterprise (SCIM: No, SAML: paid add-on) and Ultimate (both included). The row follows the per-plan table.

open_questions: Enterprise and Ultimate prices are not published.
SCIM docs do not say whether hard delete is supported, whether updates use PUT or PATCH, or whether filtering and pagination work.
Whether deactivation frees a seat or ends sessions is not documented.
No Entra ID, Google Workspace or JumpCloud provisioning guide was found; Entra gallery listing not checked beyond the Microsoft Learn tutorial index.
Whether user-event webhooks exist was not checked.
